text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 13

PATENTS ORDER, 201 1 (S 5712011) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section l ( 1 ) of the Patents Order, 2011, the Attorney General, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 23rd April 2019 as the date on which Part XIX of that Order shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 8th. day of Rejab, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 3rd. day of March. 2020.

DATO SERI PADLIKA AWANG HAJI HAIROL ARNI BIN HAJI ABDUL MAJID Attorney General. Dicetak oleh Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
